premises.text: Food waste is a significant issue contributing to greenhouse gas emissions
premises.evidence_span: if we were a country, it would be the third largest greenhouse gas emitter after China and the US

premises.text: A large percentage of fruit produced is lost or wasted each year
premises.evidence_span: Almost 30% of all fruit produced is lost or wasted every year

premises.text: Current synthetic pesticides are harmful and being banned
premises.evidence_span: currently used pesticides are synthetic compounds, which are harmful to human beings and the environment, so they are being banned

premises.text: Natural waxes exist but scaling them is challenging
premises.evidence_span: even though there are natural waxes available that might come from plant or insect compounds, scaling up these solutions is a real challenge

premises.text: Microbial fermentation can be used to create edible coatings for food preservation
premises.evidence_span: we harness the power of microbial fermentation to protect our food

premises.text: The coating regulates gas exchange and delays ripening
premises.evidence_span: regulates the gas exchange between the fruit and the environment, delaying the ripening process

premises.text: The coating enhances the delivery of antimicrobials while using minimal doses
premises.evidence_span: provides a structural matrix, preventing the drift and enhancing the delivery of the antimicrobials, allowing us to use very little doses of these molecules and still get meaningful results

premises.text: The product can be marketed as having zero chemical residues
premises.evidence_span: customers will be able to market their produce as zero chemical residues, capturing a price premium and without compromising decay control

premises.text: The product extends the shelf life of produce
premises.evidence_span: our coating also extends the shelf life of produce, acclimatory fruits like avocados, gaining up to five days of shelf life in ripening chambers

premises.text: The product integrates seamlessly with existing machinery
premises.evidence_span: The product integrates seamlessly with existing machinery, so there is no need to invest in special equipment

value.text: Food waste can be reduced without compromising human or planetary health
value.evidence_span: help us fight against food waste and food insecurity, without compromising human or planetary health
